purpose: Fixes both findings from rc6's QA verdict (session 019ffd79-1dc8-7b02-a665-73a510859535, FAIL) and changes nothing else. RC6-QA-001 (blocker): every one of rc6's ten embedded fenced bundle sections carried one extra blank line before its closing fence, so an extracted section's SHA-256 never matched the manifested/live file's SHA-256. rc7_review_bundle.v1.md is regenerated by a small deterministic script that writes each fenced section as the opening fence, the file's exact bytes, and the closing fence on the very next line -- verified byte-identical for all ten sections before this snapshot was taken. RC6-QA-002 (major): tests/test_execution_package_v2.py exercised the real `scan_node.py --node N20_PROVIDER_TRANSPORT --graph implementation.graph.v6.yaml` command (the exact command that reached BLOCKED with 16 violations under graph v5, finding N20V2-F01) without asserting it now returns exit code 0, valid/ok true, or an empty violations list. This snapshot strengthens that existing test with those assertions and adds a new dedicated test, test_n20_real_node_scoped_scan_is_the_regression_proof_that_n20v2_f01_is_fixed, proving N20's real node-scoped scan passes with zero violations against the real repository and real graph. tests/test_execution_package_v2.py is the only file this snapshot changes; every other file is byte-identical to rc6's own copy.

findings_fixed.title: Embedded sections are not byte-identical to the manifested files
findings_fixed.fix: Rebuilt rc7_review_bundle.v1.md with a deterministic script that inserts no extra blank line before any closing fence; independently re-verified all ten sections' extracted SHA-256 against the live files before freezing this snapshot.

findings_fixed.fix: Strengthened test_n20_node_mode_includes_its_newly_owned_egress_module_and_test with assert code == 0 / payload['ok'] is True / payload['valid'] is True / payload['violations'] == [], and added test_n20_real_node_scoped_scan_is_the_regression_proof_that_n20v2_f01_is_fixed asserting the same in-process via scanner.run_node against the real graph, scoped to N20 alone (N30/N40/N50 legitimately still surface pre-existing, unrelated violations in their own test files, proven separately by the pre-existing test_complete_tree_mode_against_the_real_repo_reports_the_known_pre_remediation_debt).

corrects_prior_generation_finding.note: rc6's own underlying engineering content -- the N20V2-F01 graph-level fix -- was never in question and is unchanged. rc1 through rc6 are preserved exactly as they were and are not reopened, edited, or overridden by this snapshot.
